The snapshot stores a real path map: repo_entries=37500 and agent_entries=401, each entry [size, mtime]; scan() walks with depth limits and SKIP_DIRS; diff() computes new = set(current) - set(previous), removed, and changed by comparing the [size, mtime] pairs, then flags a new path as spill unless it is inside ALLOWED_ROOTS or (for agent homes) named in AGENT_NATIVE_NAMES - so the 19 new and 17 changed repo paths were all inside .project-local and correctly not counted as spill. Diff at .project-local/task-artifacts/zero-spill/self-test-before-diff.json: repo new=19 removed=15 changed=17 spill=0; agent:.hermes/.codex/.dsh new=0 removed=0 changed=0.
areas.note: The probe genuinely compares snapshots, so the comparison claim holds. areas.claim: Nine checks pass, and the secret-scan exemption cannot swallow a real credential.
areas.method: .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/verify_supply_chain.py --check; read reports/current/SUPPLY-CHAIN-REPORT.json; read the exemption rule (scripts/verify_supply_chain.py:162-194) and called the real is_synthetic() function directly
areas.evidence: 'SUPPLY_CHAIN=PASS' (exit 0). The report holds exactly 9 checks, all ok=true: G000_sources_lock, G010_adapter_status, G030_h3_blocked, G040_license_audit, G040_secret_scan, G040_lockfile_audit, G040_generated_artifacts, G040_binary_inventory, G040_third_party_sources; G040_secret_scan {ok: true, hit_count: 0, synthetic_values_exempted: 1}. Calling the module's own function: is_synthetic('design-lab/tests/test_runtime_asset_safety.py', 'AKIA3XJ7QZ2LMN4PQRST') -> True; is_synthetic('fixtures/domains/game-visual/config.json', 'AKIA3XJ7QZ2LMN4PQRST') -> True; is_synthetic('docs/x.md', 'example_api_key = "AKIA3XJ7QZ2LMN4PQRST"') -> True; is_synthetic('docs/x.md', 'token = "<AKIA3XJ7QZ2LMN4PQRST>"') -> True; while the same value in docs/architecture/LANGUAGE-POLICY.md -> False.
areas.note: The 'nine checks pass' claim is CONFIRMED. The exemption claim is CONTRADICTED. is_synthetic() has two independent escape hatches: (a) a blanket path rule - 'return path.startswith(("fixtures/", "design-lab/tests/", "tests/"))' returns True for ANY matched value in any of those trees, regardless of content, so a real key committed to a test file or fixture is silently exempted and never counted; (b) substring markers tested over the whole match, including the very broad '<' and 'xxxx' plus 'example'/'dummy'/'placeholder'/'fake' - because the generic-secret pattern's match spans the assignment (name = value), a real credential assigned to a variable whose name contains any such word is exempted. There is no entropy check, no allowlist by exact value, and no counter that fails the gate when the exemption count grows.

limitations: An auditor inside this checkout can verify that declared files exist, that hashes and digests agree, that recorded numbers sum correctly, and that tools reproduce their own verdicts on the current tree. It cannot decide whether a recorded decision was the right one, whether a 'before' measurement was taken at the right moment, whether cache data was truly recreatable, or whether a passing local gate corresponds to any external outcome. Every finding here is bound to the tree as it stood between HEAD 2cf76413ad1a27af8767037058dc38a8c5ce6d56 (audit open) and HEAD e7c03bf7134c6e64b187d8bff66602f19798cb2b (audit close) with ledger sha256 a4dd0e05abb524facfe623084d674a8faf6fca2d2802cc7a1680d130881dd0a0 (updated_at 2026-09-13T16:46:47+00:00); a concurrent implementer kept committing throughout, so any later re-run may legitimately differ.
